description: This Mendeley Data deposit reports specific total embodied energy and specific total weight for forty residential buildings in Cuenca, Ecuador. The authors publish version 2 under CC BY 4.0, allowing free repository access and reuse. The repository describes building coverage from 1980 to 2022, whereas the Data article labels its four-decade comparison 1980–2020; that discrepancy is retained here. These building-level quantities can inform stock-turnover simulations and comparisons of material and energy consequences of construction choices. The sample is limited to forty buildings and cannot establish a complete city inventory. File formats and the treatment of individual material lifetimes were not checked. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: STEE and STW database of 40 andean residential buildings
notes: G4-0299; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
